review.title: Review in `{{environment}}`
review.pillHint: Its done waits for your review of what it showed: nothing after it goes on until you say it is reviewed or skip the review.
review.says.not-shown: Nothing shows this work in `{{environment}}` yet, so it waits: set up a step to show it there, or skip the review.
review.says.being-set-up: Set-up step #{{quest}} shows the work in `{{environment}}`, then waits for your look.
review.says.being-set-up-nostep: A set-up step shows the work in `{{environment}}`, then waits for your look.
review.says.shown: Set-up step #{{quest}} showed it at `{{commit}}`. Look at it, then say whether it is right: the work lands only once you say it is reviewed.
review.says.not-yet: You said not yet to what #{{quest}} showed at `{{commit}}`. Its session puts right what you named, then shows it again for your look.
review.says.not-held: What you reviewed does not hold these commits: #{{quest}} was reviewed at `{{commit}}`, and work was added since. It waits for a set-up that holds it, or your skip.
review.says.unread: Whether this work waits for your review could not be read, so nothing lands until it can be.
review.says.reviewed: You reviewed it at `{{commit}}`: what it held goes on.
review.says.skipped: You skipped the review of this work: it lands without one.
review.says.none: This set-up step was declined: nothing of it is reviewed.
review.choice.on: a review in the default environment
review.setUp.again: To show it again by hand
review.setUp.elsewhere: local, on {{machine}}, where its tab is
review.setUp.unserved: No longer shown: a reload there loads your own server. Show it again to serve its build.
review.setUp.nothingSaid: It said nothing of what it showed.
review.act.skip: Skip the review for this work…
review.ask.notYetTitle: Not yet: say what is not right
review.ask.notYet: Say what is not right yet. Your words go to set-up step #{{quest}}'s session as its next turn, and the tab is no longer shown while it puts it right.
review.ask.notYetOwn: Say what is not right yet. That set-up was your own, so no session hears your words: they are kept on the quest and its ask.
review.ask.skipTitle: Skip the review of this work
review.ask.skip: Skip the review of this work: it lands without being shown to you. Your words, if you give any, are kept with it.
review.ask.skipWords: why, if you want to say
review.said.notYet: Your words went to session {{session}} as its next turn.
review.said.notYetUnheard: Your words are kept, and no session here heard them: say them to session {{session}} from Daoris's window, or `daoris-driver sessions say {{session}} "…"`.
